# Handoff Acknowledged

## Quick Assessment

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS | Delta |
|--------|----------|-----------|-------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 | -0.142 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 | -0.380 ⚠️ |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** | ≈0 |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** | +0.213 ✓ |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% | -1.9% |

## Status Interpretation

✅ **Champion v5 holds** — candidate showed better lockbox robustness but unacceptable tuning_min (0.05 = near-zero on one fold) and worse drawdown profile.

⏳ **Runloop healthy** — 330 iterations, ~12.5h remaining. No stuck INCONCLUSIVE candidates.

## Recommended Actions

```bash
# Execute provided next commands in sequence:
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Watch Items
1. **tuning_min threshold** — Candidate's 0.05 suggests potential overfit on specific fold; monitor next candidates
2. **MDD creep** — Last candidate hit -11.2%; ensure risk bounds enforced
3. **Time budget** — With 12.5h left, prioritize high-confidence experiments

Ready to continue or need specific drill-down on any metric?
